# Real-data results (generated by scripts/run_btc.py)

Data: Coin Metrics Community Data (github.com/coinmetrics/data, csv/btc.csv, CC BY-NC 4.0). Sample 2014-02-01 to 2026-05-23, T = 4495 daily observations. Covariates: logrv = log of 10-day realised volatility of daily log returns; exflow = (exchange inflow - outflow) / 30-day mean of total exchange flow, native units.
